I was wondering how people would feel about adding some sort of flair for people that help out by resolving "Request" and "Unresolved" threads.

I think it would be a fun way to encourage more people to help out, as well as provide some sort of "reward" for users who just want to see big numbers next to their names to fill the empty voids in their lives....

Here's a mock up of for something simple.

Example image: https://veuwer.com/i/2ue9.png (including light and dark theme)

Example CSS:

#container a[href^="/user/"]:after{padding:1px;vertical-align:bottom;font-size:0.8em;margin-left:3px;color:#000;border:1px solid #888;border-radius:3px;} 
.dark #container a[href^="/user/"]:after{padding:1px;vertical-align:bottom;font-size:0.8em;margin-left:3px;color:#fff;border:1px solid #888;border-radius:3px;}

#container a[href="/user/j_"]:after{content:"9001";}
#container a[href="/user/Xestrix"]:after{content:"21";}
#container a[href="/user/Username"]:after{content:"#";}
[META] Give users flair for submitting accepted resolutions.

Great idea. I know you’re a frequent and helpful contributor here, and I agree it’d be nice to reward contributors (even if trivially).

What do you propose the flair text be? Do you want a custom one for yourself, or do we have some fixed choices? Without a user flair feature like Reddit (yet) these will of course have to be set by mods manually.
